en: Iyolin - What is the enemy's situation now?
Duran - They are gathering the survivors from Cutis and Astania at Castle Pandragon. But reinforcements from the Imperial homeland or the Cyrups garrison don't seem to have arrived yet.
Daicus - Then we should be able to crush them without much trouble.
Arcia - Not necessarily. Above all, the Empire still has magic armor, and they may have some trap prepared.

Duran - Even if we win in Pandragon, the problem is Thunderdoom. The fortress of Thunderdoom, at the strategic pass between Cyrups and Pandragon, is the Empire's greatest stronghold and said to be impregnable. Once reinforcements arrive from the homeland it will be even harder to take, so we must strike Thunderdoom right after retaking Pandragon. These are not my ideas but Lord Draupnir's direct orders.

Iyolin - If we take Thunderdoom, we can advance to Cyrups without much resistance. And from Cyrups we will border the Grand Duchy of Trisys, the greatest gateway to the Empire. Lord Draupnir expects that if we can win the cooperation of Bifrost, neutral until now, we can press Trisys from both Cyrups and Bifrost.
Daicus - Can we really expect help from Bifrost, which has always clung to neutrality?
Iyolin - That is why Lord Draupnir of Dagal intends to send GS to Bifrost. GS is close to Grand Duke Mozel of Bifrost, so we hope he can at least get them to divide the Trisys army's attention.
